paper_id: An Exceptional Dataset For Rare Pancreatic Tumor Segmentation
title: An Exceptional Dataset For Rare Pancreatic Tumor Segmentation
motivation: pNETs占胰腺癌不到5%，现有数据集混合多种肿瘤类型，导致pNET分割模型精度低、灵敏度差
problem_framing: 将pNET诊断问题重新定义为数据稀缺问题：需专门收集469例pNET患者构建专用CECT数据集
key_insight: slice-wise weight loss赋予大肿瘤面积切片更高权重，确保模型学习到更多可区分的肿瘤特征
method_signature: pNET专用CECT数据集(469例3D样本) + UNet++ baseline + 按肿瘤面积排名的slice-wise weight loss
evaluation_criteria: Dice Similarity Coefficient (DSC)分别在pancreas切片和ROI切片上评估，区分假阳性与召回率
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: UNet在ROI上DSC反而从0.392降至0.347，slice-wise weight loss对不同架构效果不一致
evidence_for_taste: there has not been a dataset specifically for pNETs
small pNETs may not alter the morphology
slices with larger tumor ground-truths might be more obvious
baselines using typical segmentation architectures can be improved
the rarity of pNETs makes segmenting them a challenging problem
thinking_moves: 从临床诊断痛点反推数据需求：先定义肿瘤类型专属数据集的必要性
承认基线模型局限，明确提出leave room for improvement列举后续改进方向
使用slice-wise weighting解决类别不平衡，而非简单过采样或降采样
